newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Irkutsk region takes bids to lead Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia Irkutsk region takes bids to lead Eurobond.

text.p: The All-Russian Bank for Regional Development, agent bank for Russia's Irkutsk region Eurobond issue, plans to finish accepting bids for the lead manager's position in about two weeks, a bank official said on Monday.
Planning department head Yevgeny Petrov told Reuters the bank already had received bids from Societe Generale and Salomon Brothers.
He said the bank expected bids from ING-Barings, ABN-Amro and possibly Morgan Stanley.
Irkutsk region, located in Siberia, plans to issue $80 million in dollar-denominated Eurobonds at end 1997 or start 1998.
